crawl_runner:
usage: crawl_runner.py [-h] [--db DB] [--config CONFIG] [--run-root RUN_ROOT]
                       [--execution-state-root EXECUTION_STATE_ROOT] [--max-jobs MAX_JOBS]
                       [--max-parallel-platforms MAX_PARALLEL_PLATFORMS] [--site SITE]
                       [--kind KIND] [--job-key JOB_KEY] [--start-page START_PAGE]
                       [--resume-summary RESUME_SUMMARY] [--recovery-keyword RECOVERY_KEYWORD]
                       [--sync-only] [--no-sync-config] [--dry-run] [--headless] [--headful]
                       [--no-throttle] [--no-import]

Run configured crawl jobs with deterministic scheduling.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db DB               SQLite database path.
  --config CONFIG       Crawl target config JSON.
  --run-root RUN_ROOT   Directory for run summaries.
  --execution-state-root EXECUTION_STATE_ROOT
                        Directory for frozen per-job execution states.
  --max-jobs MAX_JOBS   Maximum due jobs to run in this invocation.
  --max-parallel-platforms MAX_PARALLEL_PLATFORMS
                        Maximum platform lanes to execute concurrently; jobs in the same platform
                        lane remain serial.
  --site SITE           Optional site_key filter.
  --kind KIND           Optional job_kind filter.
  --job-key JOB_KEY     Run one specific job key.
  --start-page START_PAGE
                        Recovery-only platform page to start from.
  --resume-summary RESUME_SUMMARY
                        Recovery-only prior MediaCrawler summary to include and freeze.
  --recovery-keyword RECOVERY_KEYWORD
                        Recovery-only alternative keyword used for the continuation.
  --sync-only           Only sync config into crawl_jobs.
  --no-sync-config      Do not sync config before selecting jobs.
  --dry-run             Plan jobs and commands without executing them.
  --headless            Pass headless mode to browser jobs.
  --headful             Pass headed mode to browser jobs when supported.
  --no-throttle         Forward --no-throttle to child scripts.
  --no-import           Do not import capture results after successful jobs.
ctf_resource_crawl:
usage: ctf_resource_crawl.py [-h]
                             [--sites {weibo,xhs,bilibili,douyin,zhihu} [{weibo,xhs,bilibili,douyin,zhihu} ...]]
                             [--urls URLS [URLS ...]] [--site-label SITE_LABEL]
                             [--configured-site-urls] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--headless]
                             [--max-scrolls MAX_SCROLLS] [--behavior-profile BEHAVIOR_PROFILE]
                             [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--commit-timeout COMMIT_TIMEOUT]
                             [--readiness-timeout READINESS_TIMEOUT]
                             [--settle-min-ms SETTLE_MIN_MS] [--settle-max-ms SETTLE_MAX_MS]
                             [--douyin-cookie-cleanup {auto,off}]
                             [--scrapling-preflight {auto,off}]
                             [--scrapling-preflight-timeout SCRAPLING_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT]
                             [--no-throttle] [--keyword KEYWORD]

Crawl configured CTF targets and summarize image resources.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sites {weibo,xhs,bilibili,douyin,zhihu} [{weibo,xhs,bilibili,douyin,zhihu} ...]
                        Configured site keys.
  --urls URLS [URLS ...]
                        Explicit URLs. Use with optional --site-label.
  --site-label SITE_LABEL
                        Label for explicit URLs.
  --configured-site-urls
                        Treat explicit --urls as targets for the configured --site-label, reusing
                        that site's policy, browser profile, mobile context, and engine.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output root.
  --headless            Run browser headless.
  --max-scrolls MAX_SCROLLS
                        Maximum scroll passes per target.
  --behavior-profile BEHAVIOR_PROFILE
                        Human-flow behavior profile name. Defaults to each site profile.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Navigation timeout in milliseconds.
  --commit-timeout COMMIT_TIMEOUT
                        Short navigation commit timeout in milliseconds.
  --readiness-timeout READINESS_TIMEOUT
                        Content readiness timeout in milliseconds.
  --settle-min-ms SETTLE_MIN_MS
                        Minimum post-load settle wait.
  --settle-max-ms SETTLE_MAX_MS
                        Maximum post-load settle wait.
  --douyin-cookie-cleanup {auto,off}
                        Rotate Douyin persistent cookies before and after capture.
  --scrapling-preflight {auto,off}
                        Run a Scrapling static SSR preflight before browser resource accounting
                        when useful.
  --scrapling-preflight-timeout SCRAPLING_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT
                        Scrapling static preflight timeout in seconds.
  --no-throttle         Skip shared crawl policy checks.
  --keyword KEYWORD     Optional search keyword to record in capture_meta for downstream import.

                        MediaCrawler login type.

  --media-root MEDIA_ROOT
                        Immutable local image root. Overrides are restricted to the project temp
                        directory.
  --headed              Run browser with visible UI.
  --db DB               SQLite database path for web_posts import.
  --required-fields-profile REQUIRED_FIELDS_PROFILE
  --behavior-profile BEHAVIOR_PROFILE
  --xhs-account-id XHS_ACCOUNT_ID
                        Required isolated account id for the XHS low-level executor.
  --xhs-profile-dir XHS_PROFILE_DIR
                        Required run-scoped browser profile for XHS.
  --xhs-post-interaction {none,comment-scroll,like-one,random}
                        Optional one-post visible XHS interaction selected by xhs_runner.py.
  --start-page START_PAGE
                        Recovery-only first platform page.
  --start-offset START_OFFSET
                        Saved platform offset for the discovery frontier.
  --start-cursor START_CURSOR
                        Saved opaque platform cursor for the discovery frontier.
  --resume-summary RESUME_SUMMARY
                        Recovery-only prior summary whose JSONL records join this run.
  --discovery-job-id DISCOVERY_JOB_ID
  --discovery-query-fingerprint DISCOVERY_QUERY_FINGERPRINT
  --discovery-run-id DISCOVERY_RUN_ID
  --top-refresh-max-pages TOP_REFRESH_MAX_PAGES
  --discovery-source-exhausted
  --no-checkpoint-write
  --no-import           Do not import MediaCrawler JSONL records into SQLite.
  --zhihu-detail-urls-file ZHIHU_DETAIL_URLS_FILE
                        Diagnostic-only JSON array of Zhihu answer/article URLs to inspect via
                        detail mode.
  --xhs-detail-urls-file XHS_DETAIL_URLS_FILE
                        Existing XHS note URLs to inspect via detail mode; only allowed with
                        --xhs-repair.
  --xhs-repair-target-ids-file XHS_REPAIR_TARGET_IDS_FILE
                        JSON array of existing XHS post IDs allowed in --xhs-repair mode.
  --xhs-repair          Repair existing XHS rows from specified note detail URLs without discovery
                        writes.
  --xhs-repair-batch-size XHS_REPAIR_BATCH_SIZE
                        Number of isolated XHS repair candidates processed per in-browser batch.
  --post-repair         Repair an explicit allowlist of existing Douyin, Weibo, or Zhihu rows
                        through platform detail mode without discovery writes.
  --repair-targets-file REPAIR_TARGETS_FILE
                        Frozen JSON array of repair target objects containing platform_post_id,
                        detail_target, and keyword; requires --post-repair.
